narrative:
## Handover Summary — Opex & Capex

Opex is set at GBP 302M and capex at GBP 245M, inside the GBP 250M envelope.

## Key Decisions
- Oracle EPM and Business Objects decommission built into the FY2027 run-rate
- Cortex AI claims triage funded for Bupa Global
- Two London clinic openings brought forward to H1

## Recommendations for Rolling Forecast
- Track clinic ramp weekly against the Step 1 targets
- Stress the capex plan for a 10% construction cost overrun

## Risk Factors
- PeopleSoft GL replacement timing and its effect on finance opex
- Care-home refurbishment contractor capacity

signals.title: PeopleSoft GL Approaching End of Support
signals.excerpt: Any GL replacement must feed the planning model directly, avoiding a new reconciliation layer between ledger and plan.

signals.title: Oracle EPM BU Planning Paused
signals.excerpt: Business-unit planning on Oracle EPM has been paused. Group planning already runs on Snowflake after the TM1 to Anaplan to Snowflake migration delivered with EY.
